title: 烤肉醬借一下
subject: Mid-Autumn night in a lane where every family barbecues on the pavement, and a son sent from grill to grill to get his mother's borrowed bottle of barbecue sauce back
caption: Mandarin new jack swing in the late-1980s Teddy Riley style. A swung drum machine beat with a hard gated snare and shuffled sixteenth hi-hats; punchy synth-brass stabs on the off-beats; a slap-style synth bass line; a bright digital electric piano playing stacked chords; finger snaps and hand claps on the backbeat. Crisp bright late-1980s mix, dry drums up front, wide synths. Male tenor, smooth and playful with short melismatic runs, trading call-and-response lines with a group of backing singers on the chorus. 106 BPM, G minor. Rowdy, neighbourly and teasing. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no live horn section, no EDM drop, no modern rap verse.
lyrics:
[Intro - synth-brass stabs and swung drum machine]

[Verse 1]
中秋節晚上 整條巷子都在冒煙
阿伯穿著汗衫 拿扇子猛搧炭
三樓阿姨的玉米 已經烤到第二輪
我媽回頭一看 說醬咧 醬去哪了

[Pre-Chorus]
隔壁借走 又被隔壁的隔壁借走
兒子 去把醬拿回來

[Chorus - Call and Response]
烤肉醬 借一下 (借一下)
從巷頭 一路問到巷尾
每一家 都說剛剛還在
烤肉醬 借一下 整條巷子同一罐

[Verse 2]
王家的香腸 硬塞兩根給我
林家的小孩 頭上戴著柚子皮
樓下的黃狗 在桌子底下等肉片
月亮好圓 可是沒有人在看

[Pre-Chorus]
最後在巷尾 找到那一罐
我一擠 只剩下一滴

[Chorus - Call and Response]
烤肉醬 借一下 (借一下)
空罐子 我拿回去交差
我媽笑一笑 說沒關係
明年 我們先買三罐

[Outro - synth stabs and hand claps]
借一下 借一下
月亮 你要不要也來一串
